meanings.morph: infinitive; present, 1st/3rd person plural and formal Sie

sentences.en: When do we get the money?

sentences.review: 'Was bekommen Sie?' is ambiguous out of context: a server says it to mean 'What can I get you?', but a customer also says it to mean 'What do I owe you?'; add a note covering both uses.

sentences.text: Wo kann man hier etwas zu essen bekommen?
sentences.en: Where can you get something to eat around here?

sentences.review: 'die Arbeit bekommen' for 'got the job' is a bit unnatural, since natives say 'die Stelle' or 'den Job'; consider 'Er hat Arbeit bekommen' ('He got work/found a job') or adjust the translation.

sentences.text: Ich habe nie Geld von ihm bekommen.
sentences.en: I never got any money from him.

sentences.text: Was hast du von deinen Eltern bekommen?
sentences.en: What did you get from your parents?
